reviews.title: 1TB semi-fast, working NVME drive
reviews.comment: I should have been more thorough in testing this drive when I picked it up, but instead I threw it directly into an external NVME to USB enclosure and plugged it into a Mini PC running Proxmox. Then I promptly paired it with another SSD (via USB) I had laying around and created a mirrored disk pool in TrueNAS. So, it's not the typical use case, but it speaks to the ease of use for this drive. The quality is fine. I haven't had any issues with heat or crashes. The speed is also fast, but since it's mirrored with a slower drive, I can't speak for the max specs. I can only say it's fast enough for my needs. The capacity also matches exactly with another 1TB ssd that I had on hand, so I assume it's not shortchanging the size. Overall, it's a good value if you need a 1TB nvme ssd and don't want to pay the $100/tb surcharge for buying brand name products. As for fit, it fits into my external enclosure which has very little room for extras, so it'll probably fit into anything that needs a slim nvme drive.

reviews.title: Boost your system’s storage—fast, reliable, and perfect for slow mechanical disk upgrades!
reviews.comment: The FX660 1TB M.2 SSD is a high-performance storage upgrade designed for PCs, laptops, and PS5. With PCIe Gen 4x4 technology and dynamic SLC caching, it delivers blazing-fast speeds of up to 4800MB/s, ensuring quick boot times, faster file transfers, and improved gaming performance. Its M.2 2280 form factor makes it a versatile choice for various devices. Pros: High-Speed Performance – Read speeds up to 4800MB/s for smooth multitasking. PCIe Gen 4x4 Support – Optimized for modern systems and gaming consoles. Dynamic SLC Cache – Enhances responsiveness and reduces latency. Compact M.2 2280 Design – Fits a wide range of laptops, desktops, and PS5. Reliable & Efficient – Low power consumption with improved durability. Cons: Limited to PCIe 4.0 Devices – Older systems may not fully utilize its speed. No Included Heatsink – May require additional cooling for intensive workloads. Summary: The FX660 1TB M.2 SSD is an excellent choice for those looking to upgrade their system’s storage speed and efficiency. Whether for gaming, professional tasks, or everyday use, its high-speed performance and reliability make it a worthwhile investment for modern devices.

reviews.title: Port Incompatibility
reviews.comment: Device worked as it should, just not in my system. Was unaware of the variation in the M.2 ports and after a lot of hassle realized the M.2 on my motherboard was a Key E and incompatible with anything but wi-fi adapters.  Luckily the drive works just fine in a PS5 and as of yet no issues.
